script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Market night, round three. I've been keeping notes: so far the crew has done tacos and viet there.

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Next on my list is burgers. There's a whole cluster of grill stalls by the fountain.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: BURGERS. cyrus i would follow your list off a cliff

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: grill stalls?? i'm down. racing all of you there

script.speaker: maya
script.text: i'm in, but tonight gets its own line in my trip spreadsheet. it's a very small line

script.speaker: liam
script.text: how small are we talking

script.speaker: maya
script.text: cheapest-stall small. a little over and i'll sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate

script.speaker: mina
script.text: we'll keep it cheap, maya :) it's so nice to have five of us tonight. how's everyone's week been?

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Long. Which is why I also did some homework: at least one grill here brushes satay sauce on everything. Satay and I have history, so that stall is crossed out.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: say no more. anything peanut-y stays on the far side of the fountain

script.speaker: liam
script.text: also tonight is my redemption burger night

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: redemption for what??

script.speaker: liam
script.text: the plate of fries. burger night on campus, i had a double stack and mina ate a plate of fries because nothing else on the menu worked for her. i still think about it

script.speaker: mina
script.text: they were really good fries! liam worries too much :)

script.speaker: liam
script.text: not this time. mina gets a burger with zero meat in it, picked off the board like the rest of us

script.speaker: mina
script.text: honestly, ordering off the board like everyone else sounds like a treat. i'll hold you to it :)

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok i'm getting the most loaded burger in the whole market. everything on it

script.speaker: maya
script.text: roxy, most loaded usually means three kinds of cheese. are you trying to film a milkshake incident sequel?

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...no sequel. hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake. my stomach makes the rules

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: assistant, pick us a stall. i'm racing liam to the fountain!!
